title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf Funding Secured
items.text: LIV Golf CEO Scott O’Neil confirmed a signed deal with an unnamed lead investor to fund the league beyond 2026 and shift player incentives to majority equity ownership as Saudi PIF support ends.

items.headline: LPGA Returns To Western New York
items.text: The Corning Classic returns to the LPGA schedule in 2027 as “The Classic” with a $5 million purse, scheduled for May 27-30, marking one of the highest non-major paydays.
